name: napoleon-np-v
_comment: Row NP acceptance drive (NAPOLEON_SPEC §13 NP-V): the Emperor leaves the Seat, marches to the front, fights under his own hand, and the court reacts. Exercises the NP-1 address forms (named, 'the Emperor', first-person, the 'myself' suffix), the NP-5 Seat departure note, the NP-2 aura/fear in a real battle, and the NP-3 shadow over a marshal fighting beside him. `turns` keys are the driver's 1-based LOOP INDEX (PC15-H).
